address: 83 Phan Tu Street, My An Ward, Ngu Hanh Son District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: People flock here for its famous duck porridge. A local duck breed from Cẩm Nam Island, rice, mung beans and coix seeds are slowly simmered in duck broth for a creamy, hearty meal. Poached duck and duck salad are also available....
